rows.grounds: compound of aṇimā (minuteness) with ādi/āṇi (and-other) guṇa (qualities) and aiśvarya (sovereignty, lordly-power); refers to powers such as aṇimā etc., as per Vaiṣṇava tantric usage
compound of muktā (pearl), rala/ratna (gem), ādya/audya (and-other), and akṣaya (imperishable, inexhaustible); denotes inexhaustible wealth of pearls, gems, etc.; segmentation uncertain due to form
